title: Father Peter Rinaldi's meeting on the Shroud of Turin
summary: Whitley Strieber tells of Father Peter Rinaldi's meeting on the Shroud of Turin, about 1970s at New York, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: a father Peter Raldi who Anne knew uh calls us up one day calls her up one day and says I want you to come to a meeting we're having a meeting about the shroud of turret

plain: Whitley Strieber, a writer, says that sometime in the 1970s in New York, a priest named Father Peter Rinaldi, a friend of Strieber's wife Anne, called her and invited them to a meeting. According to Strieber, the meeting was about the Shroud of Turin, an old linen cloth that some believe wrapped the body of Jesus. He tells it, on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, as part of how he came to deeper mysteries, and he says he was there.
